pages.text: A $(l:goetymech_crafts/twisted_embryo)Twisted Embryo$(/l) transformed by the $(l:goetymech_machines/flesh_furnace)Flesh Furnace$(/l). Spend a bit of soul energy to turn it into a soldier; if soul energy is insufficient, it can be forcibly converted at half health.$(br)Through the $(l:goetymech_machines/squad_barracks)Squad Barracks$(/l) and $(l:goetymech_focuses/squad_focus)Squad Focus$(/l), you can use them more conveniently.$(br)$(4)"Rise, soldier."$()
